preconditions.description: The length of the string n is between 1 and 200000 inclusive.
The number of operations m is between 1 and 200000 inclusive.
The length of the string s is exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r, c in operations)
preconditions.description: For each operation, the positions l and r are between 1 and n inclusive, and l is less than or equal to r.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) and len(c) == 1 for l, r, c in operations)
preconditions.description: For each operation, the character c is a single small or large English letter or a digit.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join([char for char in s if all(char != c or not (l <= s.index(char) + 1 <= r) for l, r, c in operations)])
postconditions.description: The return value is the string obtained by removing all characters c from positions l to r for each operation.
